request.project_task: Build a university course registration portal.
request.project_goal: Let students enroll while enforcing prerequisites and capacity.
request.project_description: Students search courses, enroll or join a waitlist, and drop future courses.

functional_requirements.text: A student searches courses by term and subject.

atoms.text: A student searches courses by term and subject.

functional_requirements.text: A student enrolls in an eligible course.

atoms.text: A student enrolls in an eligible course.

functional_requirements.text: A student joins a waitlist when a course is full.

atoms.text: A student joins a waitlist when a course is full.

functional_requirements.text: A student drops a future course.

atoms.text: A student drops a future course.

non_functional_requirements.text: Enrollment updates must be serializable to prevent oversubscription.

actors.name: Student
actors.description: A university student who searches, enrolls in, waitlists for, and drops courses.

use_cases.name: Search Courses
use_cases.goal: Find courses by term and subject.

success_postconditions.text: Matching courses are displayed to the student.

failure_postconditions.text: No matching courses are found and an empty result is shown.

main_success_scenario.name: Search courses by term and subject

steps.action: Student selects a term and subject.

user_stories.capability: search courses by term and subject
user_stories.benefit: I can find courses I want to take

system_stories.system_action: Filter courses by term and subject.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-001 — Search Courses
Goal: Find courses by term and subject.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: Student initiates a course search.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC001-001: Student is authenticated.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC001-001] Student selects a term and subject.
  2. [STEP-UC001-002] Student submits the search.
Source FRs: FR-001

use_cases.name: Enroll in Course
use_cases.goal: Enroll in an eligible course after prerequisite and capacity checks.
use_cases.trigger: Student selects a course and requests enrollment.

preconditions.text: Student has selected a course offering.

success_postconditions.text: Student is enrolled in the course and capacity is decremented.

failure_postconditions.text: Enrollment is rejected due to unmet prerequisites or full capacity.

steps.action: Student requests enrollment in a selected course.
System enrolls the student and updates capacity.

steps.expected_result: Enrollment is rejected with a prerequisite error.
Enrollment is rejected with a capacity error.

user_stories.benefit: I can secure a place in the course

system_stories.system_action: Check prerequisites and capacity, then enroll.
system_stories.responsibility: Enforce eligibility and update enrollment atomically.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-002 — Enroll in Course
Goal: Enroll in an eligible course after prerequisite and capacity checks.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: Student selects a course and requests enrollment.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC002-001: Student is authenticated.
  - PRE-UC002-002: Student has selected a course offering.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC002-001] Student requests enrollment in a selected course.
  2. [STEP-UC002-002] System checks course prerequisites.
  3. [STEP-UC002-003] System checks remaining capacity.
  4. [STEP-UC002-004] System enrolls the student and updates capacity.
Exception scenarios:
  - SCN-UC002-EXC-001: Prerequisites not met
  - SCN-UC002-EXC-002: Course full
Source FRs: FR-002, FR-003, FR-004

use_cases.name: Join Waitlist
use_cases.goal: Join a waitlist when a course is full.
use_cases.trigger: Student attempts to enroll in a full course.

preconditions.text: Student has selected a full course offering.

success_postconditions.text: Student is added to the course waitlist.

failure_postconditions.text: Student is not added to the waitlist.

steps.action: Student requests to join the waitlist for a full course.
System adds the student to the waitlist.

user_stories.capability: join a waitlist when a course is full
user_stories.benefit: I can be considered if a seat opens

system_stories.system_action: Add student to waitlist for full course.
system_stories.responsibility: Maintain waitlist order and notify on availability.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-003 — Join Waitlist
Goal: Join a waitlist when a course is full.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: Student attempts to enroll in a full course.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC003-001: Student is authenticated.
  - PRE-UC003-002: Student has selected a full course offering.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC003-001] Student requests to join the waitlist for a full course.
  2. [STEP-UC003-002] System adds the student to the waitlist.
Source FRs: FR-005

use_cases.name: Drop Course
use_cases.trigger: Student selects an enrolled future course and requests to drop it.

preconditions.text: Student is enrolled in a future course.

success_postconditions.text: Student is dropped from the course and capacity is incremented.

steps.action: Student requests to drop a future course.
System removes the student from the course and updates capacity.

system_stories.system_action: Remove student from course and update capacity.
system_stories.responsibility: Ensure drop is allowed only for future courses.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-004 — Drop Course
Goal: Drop a future course.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: Student selects an enrolled future course and requests to drop it.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC004-001: Student is authenticated.
  - PRE-UC004-002: Student is enrolled in a future course.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC004-001] Student requests to drop a future course.
  2. [STEP-UC004-002] System removes the student from the course and updates capacity.
Source FRs: FR-006

issues.message: Edge ADE-UC001-001 must link to UC step(s) or be marked unsupported

The decision node 'Matching courses found?' and its 'no courses found' branch are not explicitly stated in the UC main success scenario, though they are consistent with the declared failure postcondition POST-UC001-002. This is a non-blocking decomposition detail.

The display actions (ADN-UC001-005, ADN-UC001-006) are traced to STEP-UC001-002, whose expected result is 'System returns matching courses.' This is an acceptable equivalent decomposition of the step's expected result.

details.summary: The activity diagram preserves both UC main steps and the declared success/failure postconditions. Accepted with non-blocking notes.
